scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.config.content.ts && vite build --config vite.config.background.ts
scripts.build:prod: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm run pack:dist && npm run publish:tag
scripts.build:prod:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm run pack:dist && npm run publish:tag
scripts.build:prod:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm run pack:dist && npm run publish:tag
